```{r preparation}
#install.packages("gllvm")
library(gllvm)
#library(tidyverse)
set.seed(0)
data(microbialdata)
microbial = data.frame(microbialdata)
dim(microbial)

Xenv = microbial[, 986:991]
df_noXenv = microbial %>%  #no X variables 
    dplyr::select(-(Xenv.SOM:Xenv.Soiltype))
```

```{r running gllvm 1 l.v.}

# get true model and its predictions
model_and_pred = function(Y, X, l.v.){
  true_model = gllvm(Y, X, num.lv = l.v., family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA")
  pred_counts = predict(true_model, type = 'response', lv.pred=TRUE) 
  return(list(Y = Y, X = X, true_model = true_model, pred_counts = pred_counts))
}

# simulate B times and refit model
glvm = function(Y, X, l.v., B){
  time = rep(NA, B)
  KL = rep(NA, B)
  model_pred = model_and_pred(Y, X, l.v.)
  for (i in 1:B){
    sim_counts = simulate(model_pred$true_model, nsim = 1, conditional = TRUE)
    sim_counts = as.matrix(sim_counts)
    
    time_i = system.time({
      model_i = gllvm(sim_counts, X, num.lv = l.v., family = poisson(link = 'log'), method = "LA")}) 
    time[i] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
    pred_counts_i = predict(model_i, type = 'response', lv.pred = TRUE) #account for latent variable
    
    KL.ij = model_pred$pred_counts*(log(model_pred$pred_counts/pred_counts_i)) - (model_pred$pred_counts - pred_counts_i) 
    KL[i] = sum(KL.ij)
  }

  
  time_int = c(mean(time), sqrt(var(time)))
  KL_int = c(mean(KL), sqrt(var(KL)))
  return(list(time = time, KL = KL, time_int = time_int, KL_int = KL_int))
}

model = glvm(microbial[, 1:200], scale(Xenv[, 1:2]), l.v. = 1, 5)
model$time
model$KL
model$time_int
model$KL_int
```

```{r alternating glms using 1 l.v.}
alt_glm = function(Y, X, l.v., B, u){
  
  Y = as.matrix(Y)
  X = as.matrix(X)

  time = rep(NA, B)
  KL = rep(NA, B)
  ite_converge_all = rep(NA, B)
  model_pred = model_and_pred(Y, X, l.v.)

  for (k in 1:B){
    sim_counts = simulate(model_pred$true_model, nsim = 1, conditional = TRUE)
    sim_counts = as.matrix(sim_counts)
    beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(Y), ncol = 1 + ncol(X) + ncol(u)) #preset matrix of coefficients including betas and lambdas, nrow = no. of columns in the responses, no. of columns = beta0, beta1, beta2, lambda
    
    N = 20
    loglik = -Inf
    time_i = system.time({
      for (j in 1:N){
        suppressWarnings(
        for (i in 1:ncol(sim_counts)){
          glm1 = glm.fit(y = sim_counts[, i], x = cbind(1, X, u), intercept = TRUE, family=poisson(link='log')) 
          beta_lambda[i, ] = t(glm1$coefficients) #1 x 4
        }
        )
        beta = beta_lambda[, 1:(ncol(X)+1)] #200 x 3
        lambda = beta_lambda[, (ncol(X) + 2):(ncol(X) + 1 + ncol(u))] #200 x 1
        
        new_X = cbind(1, X) #56 x 3
        new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(Y), ncol = ncol(u)) #56 x 1
        
        suppressWarnings(
        for (i in 1:nrow(sim_counts)){
          glm1 = glm.fit(y = as.numeric(sim_counts[i, ]), x = lambda, intercept = FALSE, family=poisson(link='log'), offset = (new_X%*%t(beta))[i, ]) #invalid type without as.numeric
          new_u[i, ] = t(glm1$coefficients) 
        }
        )
        u = new_u #56 x 1
        eta = new_X%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
        eta = pmin(pmax(eta, -20), 20) #clamping to limit the exp(eta)
        mu = exp(eta)
        loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(sim_counts), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
        if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
        loglik = loglik_new
        }
      }) 
  
    ite_converge_all[k] = j
    time[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
    pred_counts_i = mu
    KL.ij = model_pred$pred_counts*(log(model_pred$pred_counts/pred_counts_i)) - (model_pred$pred_counts - pred_counts_i) 
    KL[k] = sum(KL.ij)
  }
  
  time_int = c(mean(time), sqrt(var(time)))
  KL_int = c(mean(KL), sqrt(var(KL)))
  return(list(time = time, KL = KL, ite_converge_all = ite_converge_all, time_int = time_int, KL_int = KL_int))
}

model = alt_glm(microbial[, 1:200], scale(Xenv[, 1:2]), l.v. = 1, 5, u = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)))
model$time
model$KL
model$ite_converge_all
model$time_int
model$KL_int

```

```{r glmnet - penalty on u using 1 l.v.}
#install.packages('glmnet')
library(glmnet)

pen_lam_glmnet = function(Y, X, l.v., B, u){
  
  Y = as.matrix(Y)
  X = as.matrix(X)
  
  time = rep(NA, B)
  KL = rep(NA, B)
  ite_converge_all = rep(NA, B)
  model_pred = model_and_pred(Y, X, l.v.)

  for (k in 1:B){
    sim_counts = simulate(model_pred$true_model, nsim = 1, conditional = TRUE)
    sim_counts = as.matrix(sim_counts)
    beta_lambda = matrix(NA, nrow = ncol(Y), ncol = 1 + ncol(X) + ncol(u))
    
    N = 20
    loglik = -Inf
    time_i = system.time({
      for (j in 1:N){
        suppressWarnings(
        for (i in 1:ncol(sim_counts)){
          glm1 = glm.fit(y = sim_counts[, i], x = cbind(1, X, u), intercept = TRUE, family = poisson(link = 'log'))
          beta_lambda[i, ] = t(glm1$coefficients) #1 x 4, as.numeric and c() because it's stored as sparse matrix
        }
        )
        beta = beta_lambda[, 1:(1 + ncol(X))] #200 x 3
        lambda = as.matrix(beta_lambda[, (1 + ncol(X) + 1):(1 + ncol(X) + ncol(u))]) #200 x 1
        
        new_X = as.matrix(cbind(1, X)) #56 x 3
        new_u = matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(Y), ncol = ncol(u)) #56 x 1
      
        for (i in 1:nrow(sim_counts)){
          glmnet1 = glmnet(x = cbind(lambda, 0), y = as.numeric(sim_counts[i, ]), intercept = FALSE, family = "poisson", offset = (new_X%*%t(beta))[i, ], alpha = 0, lambda = 1)
          new_u[i, ] = t(as.numeric(glmnet1$beta)[1:ncol(lambda)])
        }
        u = new_u #56 x 1
        eta = new_X%*%t(beta) + u%*%t(lambda) #56 x 200 + 56 x 200
        mu = exp(eta)
        loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u, log = TRUE)) + sum(dpois(as.matrix(sim_counts), lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
        if(abs((loglik_new - loglik)/loglik_new) < 1e-3) break
        loglik = loglik_new
        }
      })
    
    ite_converge_all[k] = j
    time[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
    pred_counts_i = mu
    KL.ij = model_pred$pred_counts*(log(model_pred$pred_counts/pred_counts_i)) - (model_pred$pred_counts - pred_counts_i) 
    KL[k] = sum(KL.ij)
  }
  
  time_int = c(mean(time), sqrt(var(time)))
  KL_int = c(mean(KL), sqrt(var(KL)))
  return(list(time = time, KL = KL, ite_converge_all = ite_converge_all, time_int = time_int, KL_int = KL_int))
}  

model = pen_lam_glmnet(microbial[, 1:200], scale(Xenv[, 1:2]), l.v. = 1, 5, u = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)))
model$time
model$KL
model$ite_converge_all
model$time_int
model$KL_int
```

```{r alternating glms, 1 l.v. updating through constraints -- Chen}

# projection onto ball of radius c
proc = function(y, c){
  y = as.numeric(y)
  if (sqrt(sum(y^2)) <= c) return(y)
  c * y / sqrt(sum(y^2))
}

lv_chen = function(Y, X, l.v., B, K, u_all){
  
  Y = as.matrix(Y)
  X = as.matrix(X)
  
  time = rep(NA, B)
  KL = rep(NA, B)
  ite_converge_all = rep(NA, B)
  loglik_new_all = rep(NA, B)
  loglik_all = rep(NA, B)
  
  model_and_pred = model_and_pred(Y, X, l.v.)

  for (k in 1:B){
    sim_counts = simulate(model_and_pred$true_model, nsim = 1, conditional = TRUE)
    sim_counts = as.matrix(sim_counts)
    n = nrow(Y)          # 56
    J = ncol(Y)          # 200
    c = 5 * sqrt(K)
  
    beta_all = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = 1 + ncol(X))
    lambda_all = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = ncol(u_all))
  
    # initialize column parameters from Poisson GLMs without latent term
    time_i = system.time({
      for (j in 1:J) {
        fit_j = glm.fit(
          y = Y[, j],
          x = cbind(1, X, u_all), 
          family = poisson(link = "log")
        )
        coef_j = as.matrix(t(fit_j$coefficients))
        beta_all[j, ] = coef_j[1: (1 + ncol(X))]    
        lambda_all[j, ] = coef_j[(ncol(X) + 1 + 1):(ncol(X) + 1 + ncol(u_all))]
      }
      
      beta_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = 1 + ncol(X)) 
      lambda_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = J, ncol = ncol(u_all)) 
      u_proj = matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = ncol(u_all)) #56 x 1
      
      N = 20
      loglik = -Inf
      for (iter in 1:N) {
      ## ---------------------------
      ## (a) ROWS FIRST: update u_i
      ## ---------------------------
        suppressWarnings(
        for (i in 1:n) {
          
          # current offset for row i across all columns
          
          # row-wise GLM update
            glm1 = glm.fit(
            y = sim_counts[i, ],
            x = as.matrix(lambda_all),   # J x 1
            intercept = FALSE,
            family = poisson(link = "log"),
            offset = cbind(1, X)[i, ] %*% t(beta_all), # 1 x 200
            start = u_all[i, ],
            control = glm.control(maxit = 1)
          )
  
          u = as.matrix(t(glm1$coefficients))
    
          u_proj[i, ] = proc(u, sqrt(c^2 - 1))
        }
        )
        u_all = u_proj
        
        ## -----------------------------------------
        ## (b) COLUMNS SECOND: update beta_i, lambda_i
        ## -----------------------------------------
        
        X_u = cbind(1, X, u_all)
        
        suppressWarnings(
        for (j in 1:J) {
          
          start_vec = c(beta_all[j, ], lambda_all[j, ])
          
            glm1 = glm.fit(
            y = sim_counts[, j],
            x = X_u,
            family = poisson(link = "log"),
            start = start_vec,
            control = glm.control(maxit = 1))
        
          #if (!is.null(glm1) && all(is.finite(glm1$coefficients))) {
            coef_j = as.matrix(t(glm1$coefficients))
          #} else {
            #coef_j = start_vec * 0.8
          #}
          
          beta_j = coef_j[1:(1 + ncol(X))]
          lambda_j = coef_j[(ncol(X) + 1 + 1):(ncol(X) + 1 + ncol(u_all))]
          
          comb_j = c(beta_j, lambda_j) #4 x 1
          comb_proj = proc(comb_j, c)
          
          beta_proj[j, ] = comb_proj[1:(ncol(X) + 1)]
          lambda_proj[j, ] = comb_proj[(ncol(X) + 1 + 1):(ncol(X) + 1 + ncol(u_all))]
          }
        )
        beta_all = beta_proj
        lambda_all = lambda_proj
        
        ## ----------------
        ## likelihood check
        ## ----------------
        
        eta = cbind(1, X) %*% t(beta_all) + u_all %*% t(lambda_all) #56 x 200
        eta = pmin(pmax(eta, -10), 10)
        mu = exp(eta)
        
        loglik_new = sum(dnorm(u_all, log = TRUE)) +
          sum(dpois(sim_counts, lambda = mu, log = TRUE))
        
        rel_change = abs(loglik_new - loglik) / (abs(loglik_new))
        if (rel_change < 1e-3) break
        
        loglik = loglik_new
        }
      })
    
    ite_converge_all[k] = iter
    time[k] = as.numeric(time_i[3])
    pred_counts_i = mu
    KL.ij = model_and_pred$pred_counts*(log(model_and_pred$pred_counts/pred_counts_i)) - (model_and_pred$pred_counts - pred_counts_i) 
    KL[k] = sum(KL.ij)
    loglik_new_all[k] = loglik_new
    loglik_all[k] = loglik
    }  

  time_int = c(mean(time), sqrt(var(time)))
  KL_int = c(mean(KL), sqrt(var(KL)))
  
  return(list(time = time, KL = KL, ite_converge_all = ite_converge_all, time_int = time_int, KL_int = KL_int, loglik_all = loglik_all, loglik_new_all = loglik_new_all))
} 

model = lv_chen(Y = as.matrix(df_noXenv[, 1:200]), X = scale(Xenv[, 1:2]), l.v. = 1, B = 5, K = 1, u_all = as.matrix(rnorm(56, 0, 1)))

model$time
model$KL
model$ite_converge_all
model$time_int
model$KL_int
model$loglik_new_all
model$loglik_all #why different?
```
